title: Cover Load Carried by an Additional Driver on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Election
content:
A cover load is added as a share of the protection already charged on the election for the trip when an
additional driver is taken onto a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election. The protection already charged on the
election is the protection fee charged for the trip less any protection fee returned against it. The cover load
is the cover load percentage of the protection already charged, expressed as a percentage of that amount.

1. Where the protection already charged on the election for the trip reaches 1500.00 USD, the cover load
   percentage is 1.0 percent of it.
2. Where the protection already charged on the election for the trip reaches 600.00 USD but not 1500.00 USD,
   the cover load percentage is 0.6 percent of it.
3. Where it reaches neither figure, no cover load is charged and the percentage is 0.

## Both sides of the two thresholds

| Protection already charged on the election | Cover load percentage |
|---|---|
| 1499.99 USD | 0.6 percent |
| 1500.00 USD | 1.0 percent |
| 599.99 USD | 0 |
| 600.00 USD | 0.6 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election carrying 1800.00 USD of protection fee charged for the trip and no fee returned against it has
1800.00 USD already charged, which reaches the upper threshold, so the cover load is 1.0 percent of 1800.00 USD,
which is 18.00 USD.

An election carrying 900.00 USD of protection fee charged and 200.00 USD returned against it has 700.00 USD
already charged, which reaches the lower threshold but not the upper one, so the cover load is 0.6 percent of
700.00 USD, which is 4.20 USD.

An election carrying 400.00 USD of protection fee charged and nothing returned has 400.00 USD already charged,
which reaches neither threshold, and carries no cover load at all.

The amount so reached is added to the fee worked out for the additional driver.
